name: Half-Life

scale.why: player hull 72 u tall (VEC_HULL_MIN -36 .. VEC_HULL_MAX 36: pm_shared.c#L85-86), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.025 m/u

speed.note: ReHLDS (the reverse-engineered GoldSrc engine) and Xash3D default to 320; the Valve Developer wiki's HL cvar list gives 270

air_accel.note: Quark-equivalent: this engine pushes 10 x the FULL wish speed (320 u/s) per second but caps the gain at 30 u/s; Quark pushes air_accel x 10 x min(wish, air_cap), so the same push is air_accel = 10 x 320 / 30 / 10 (Xonotic's Quake port does the same: sv_airaccelerate 106.67 with sv_maxairspeed 30 for 10 x 320 / 30).

air_cap.note: the air wish-speed cap (Quark's air strafe cap, W-only; A/D raises Quark's x1.1)

overstrafe.source: same code: the push is applied in full whatever its angle to your velocity
overstrafe.note: no overstrafe softening: the whole push against your momentum applies (Quark lets 35% through)

dash.note: no dash (the long jump module is an item)

grapple.note: no grapple in multiplayer (the barnacle grapple in Opposing Force)

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; edge friction not modelled; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: long jump module: crouch + jump at speed sets 350 x 1.6 = 560 u/s forward and sqrt(2 x 800 x 56) up (pm_shared.c#L2589-2592)
bunny-hop limit: above 1.7 x maxspeed a jump crops speed to 0.65 x that (pm_shared.c#L2436-2465)
notes: Engine cvar defaults from ReHLDS (a reverse-engineered GoldSrc engine; the original engine source isn't public); the game rules (pm_shared.c) from Valve's Half-Life SDK.
